Specification: This module packages a TLA+ specification of an iterative solver for the N-queens problem together with SpecTE trace-exploration artifacts generated after TLC found an invariant violation. The modeled algorithm keeps a set of partial queen placements in `todo`, accumulates full valid placements in `sols`, and advances a program counter `pc`; the translated PlusCal action `nxtQ` extends one partial placement at a time with non-attacking queens. The file defines safety properties such as type correctness and that `sols` contains only valid solutions, a termination property `<>(pc = "Done")`, and a weak fairness condition `WF_vars(nxtQ)` used in `LiveSpec`; it also contains concrete trace sub-actions and trace-specific init/next constraints extracted from a failing model-checking run.

Len(queens) : Attacks( Append(queens, c), i, nxtQ ) } IN LET exts == { Append(queens,q) : q \in cols } IN IF (nxtQ = N) THEN /\ todo' = todo \ {queens} /\ sols' = (sols \union exts) ELSE /\ todo' = ((todo \ {queens}) \union exts) /\ sols' = sols /\ pc' = "nxtQ" ELSE /\ pc' = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED << todo, sols >>
